mentions.name: ChatShell
mentions.description: ChatShell is an open-source desktop AI agent built with Tauri 2 and Rust that ships with 9 built-in tools (web search, bash, file read/write, grep, etc.) so the AI can take real actions from the first conversation. It requires no plugins or configuration, supports 40+ providers, MCP with OAuth, and a skills system, and is released under Apache 2.0. Work in progress includes chat history search (FTS5) and OpenRouter Nano Banana 2 support.
